intro: Harlan Bagley is a human armorer and merchant operating out of the Lionheart Armory in Stormwind City's bustling Trade District. He tends his shop on the northern side of the district center, looking after arms and equipment for citizens and visiting adventurers alike.

p: Situated along the northern side of the Trade District, the Lionheart Armory serves as a steady commercial fixture within the heart of Stormwind. From behind his counter, Harlan Bagley manages inventory and deals in defensive gear, relying on incoming trade and regional couriers to keep his shelves stocked while the capital contends with distant border conflicts and supply constraints.
